questions.question: What happens when a customer finalizes their checkout and it turns into an order?
questions.answerNote: complete_checkout dispatches to complete_checkout_with_transaction (transactions flow: create_order_from_checkout) or complete_checkout_with_payment (pre-payment validation, gateway process/confirm, then _create_order); order creation copies lines/discounts/voucher usage, allocates stock and fires post-commit events.

questions.question: When an order is placed, how does it decide which warehouse stock to reserve, and what happens if there is not enough?
questions.answerNote: allocate_stocks locks the relevant Stock rows for the variants in the shipping country/channel (or collection point), allocates line quantities across stocks in order, and raises InsufficientStock when not enough is available; only track_inventory variants are allocated.

questions.question: How are event notifications sent out to installed third-party apps, and how can the app verify them?
questions.answerNote: trigger_webhooks_async creates EventDelivery rows and queues the Celery task send_webhook_request_async (retry_backoff, max 5 retries); send_webhook_using_scheme_method signs the body (signature_for_payload: HMAC-SHA256 with the secret key, else a JWS from the JWT manager) and dispatches by URL scheme (http(s), SQS, Pub/Sub).

questions.question: How is access to staff-only API operations restricted?
questions.answerNote: Mutations declare Meta.permissions (enums in saleor/permission/enums.py, e.g. MANAGE_ORDERS); BaseMutation.mutate calls check_permissions -> one_of_permissions_or_auth_filter_required / all_permissions_required and raises PermissionDenied. Query fields use PermissionsField.

questions.question: How can I plug in custom behavior, such as a different tax calculation, without changing core code?
questions.answerNote: Subclass BasePlugin and override hook methods; PluginsManager runs each hook across plugins in order, passing previous_value along the chain. Plugins are listed in settings PLUGINS = BUILTIN_PLUGINS + EXTERNAL_PLUGINS (e.g. avatax). External apps + webhooks are the newer alternative.

questions.question: Which environment variables point the app at its database, read replica and background job broker?
questions.answerNote: settings.py: DATABASES from DATABASE_URL (dj_database_url) and DATABASE_URL_REPLICA; CELERY_BROKER_URL (falls back to CLOUDAMQP_URL; tasks run eagerly when unset); CACHE_URL/REDIS_URL for cache.

questions.question: Can anyone holding a gift card code spend it, or is it tied to one customer?
questions.answerNote: ADR 0001: gift cards are bearer instruments by default (anyone with the code, incl. guest checkout); customer assignment is a separate opt-in restriction, distinct from deprecated used_by, and rejection must not leak who it is assigned to.

questions.question: Which URL do API requests arrive on, and what code processes them?
questions.answerNote: saleor/urls.py maps ^graphql/$ to GraphQLView (saleor/graphql/views.py: handle_query/execute_graphql_request) with the federated schema built in saleor/graphql/api.py.

After symlink-stripping the scan yields just one system and one container named after the root package.json (which only exists for release/tooling scripts), and zero components or code - the entire Python codebase is invisible.
